caveats.charset: Characters outside Loghi's output charset remain and count normally as errors if Loghi cannot emit them: {'æ': 2, '¼': 1}.
caveats.editorial_uncertainty: D4b excludes lines matching \?{2,}; a single '?' is retained; excluded GT text is unchanged and preserved outside the primary set.
caveats.hyphenation: Raw scoring is primary. A separately labelled secondary sensitivity score treats only line-final ¬ and line-final - as equivalent; internal ¬ or - remain different.
caveats.source_status: All 140 pages are marked IN_PROGRESS in Transkribus; none is marked GT/FINAL. This does not invalidate the dataset but limits the certainty of the reference transcription.
caveats.transcription_convention: The student transcription guidelines are unavailable. The deterministic convention audit shows convention differences between collections. The supplied GT is the reference as delivered.
